text:
mira: Heads-up — vuln scan flagged a transitive CVE in the kms-wrapper dependency used by the private-deploy KMS integration. Requesting a short-lived exception to keep the EU pilot running while we remediate. Details below.

vuln-scan-bot: scan result: repo=redwood/private-kms-integration path=third_party/kms-wrapper version=2.1.0 vuln=GHSA-9abc-xyz CVSS=6.4 link=https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/GHSA-9abc-xyz

sam: What's the vuln actually doing? Are there public exploits? Can we bump to 2.1.3?

mira: It's a protobuf parsing issue in a transitive lib. No known public exploit, but it allows malformed payloads to crash the client process under certain conditions. Patch exists in 2.1.3 but upgrading requires module changes that break our Go 1.18 build. Estimated dev effort ~2 engineer-days + testing; end-to-end upgrade takes ~10 business days with QA.

jordan: For the EU pilot we MUST keep keys in HSM and have audit logs exported. Are we keeping KMS operation audit logging with 90d retention?

alex: We can enforce audit export and add alerting. I'll also add a synthetic decrypt check. Example alert I will create: 
```
sum(rate(kms_api_errors_total[5m])) by (instance) > 0
```
This will page if KMS errors spike.

mira: Proposed compensating controls while exception is active:
- restrict KMS access to VPC peering + private endpoints
- enforce key usage policy (encrypt/decrypt only) via IAM roles
- enable CMEK-only for EU tenant keys
- export KMS audit logs to secure bucket with 90d retention and object immutability
- enable synthetic decrypt probe every hour + alerting
- exception window = 14 days

sam: Quick upgrade attempt notes: bumping kms-wrapper to 2.1.3 fails with `go mod` conflicts due to pinned transitive deps. Error: `go: github.com/example/proto@v1.4.0: needs go 1.20` — we can't move to go1.20 for this service in current sprint. We'll need a patch branch and minor refactor.

compliance: (compliance) @mira please assign a risk owner and confirm acceptance window. We default to 7 days unless security provides justification for longer. Also need documented compensating controls in the exception request.

mira: Risk owner = sam (eng-infra). Requesting 14 days because upgrade requires a small refactor and QA. Will apply compensating controls today and create a tracking ticket with checklist.

jordan: I can approve technically provided all controls are implemented and we have rollback plan if the upgrade breaks. Please include a runbook for key rotation in case of suspected compromise.

legal: Note: ensure no key material or plaintext leaves EU jurisdictions — confirm export controls are met for the EU pilot.

alex: I'll wire up the dashboard, PagerDuty rule, and synthetic probe. Will post links when done. Also adding a low-threshold alert for unusual decrypt volumes.

mira: Creating RFC/ticket now: RH-2345. Will attach: vulnerability scan output, mitigation checklist, network ACL changes, IAM policy diffs, and audit export config. Will post once audit bucket and probe are live.

vuln-scan-bot: exception-request created id=EXC-7834 scope=private-kms-integration expires=1912353078 (14 days) created_by=mira

sam: Ack, I'll take ownership of remediation work and schedule it for next sprint.

compliance: Approved for 14 days with listed compensating controls and risk owner assigned. (compliance) :white_check_mark:

legal: Thanks — confirmed export constraint check. No objections.

mira: Thanks everyone — I'll update RH-2345 with proof-of-controls and close the exception once upgrade is in prod.

alex: +1. Monitoring will be live in ~45m.

sam: +1

mira: Closing the loop here — thanks all.
